brief:
Israel's Central Elections Committee chairman ordered Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu to remove online videos in which military and public resources were used without authorization, according to Middle East Eye. The directive targets content the committee deemed election propaganda, raising questions about the use of state machinery for campaign purposes.

The committee's action follows concerns that serving officials may improperly leverage government resources and military access to boost their political standing. Netanyahu's office has not yet responded to the removal order.
